jobs.description:
Own the roadmap of the registration platform behind one of the world’s largest top-level domains, from EPP to data analytics.

Product Owner – Registration Services

Our client is a European not-for-profit organisation, human-sized and firmly technology-driven, responsible for managing and operating one of the world’s largest country-code top-level domains in the public interest.

What makes it stand out? It delivers secure, resilient and accessible registration services to millions of users across Europe, through a network of accredited registrars.

The organisation is modernising its core registration platform and shaping the next generation of services supporting the registration and management of domain names.

To drive this, it is looking for a Product Owner to define the vision, roadmap and priorities across these mission-critical activities: core registration platform, EPP, registration APIs, domain-name lifecycle, registry-to-registrar integrations, data analytics and platform modernisation.

 

The job

• Based in Diegem and working within the Technology Department, you operate at the intersection of Business Operations, Architecture and Service Design, Engineering, Service Delivery, Compliance and Security.
• Translate strategic, operational, regulatory and stakeholder needs into clear product direction and deliverable priorities, balancing immediate service improvements with long-term modernisation, resilience, security and technological sovereignty.Role
• Define and maintain the product vision, strategy and roadmap for the assigned Registration Services areas: core registration platform, EPP, registration APIs, RDAP, domain-name lifecycle and data analytics capabilities.
• Own, structure and prioritise the backlog, making transparent trade-offs between business value, urgency, risk, delivery capacity, dependencies and long-term sustainability.
• Work closely with Business Owners and with the engineering, architecture, service delivery, compliance and security teams to ensure requirements are understood, feasible and aligned.
• Give clear product direction to the Business Analysts, validate functional requirements and acceptance criteria, and own functional acceptance through to go/no-go release decisions.
• Ensure compliance with GDPR, NIS2, AI regulations and internal governance frameworks, and monitor developments within ICANN, IETF, CENTR and the wider domain-name ecosystem.
Profile
• University degree in computer science, engineering, business, information systems or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• At least seven years in technology-driven products or services, including substantial experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager. Familiarity with the domain-name ecosystem, EPP, WHOIS or RDAP and DNS provisioning is a strong asset, as is a background in telecommunications or another regulated service industry.
• Excellent written and spoken English; knowledge of other European languages is an asset.

We are looking for an Expert Electrical Engineer for a modern manufacturing company in Hooglede – someone who enjoys getting stuck in and wants to take their technical knowledge to the next level. You will be in charge of your own section within the machinery department and will become the go-to specialist that everyone turns to when things get a bit more technically challenging.

What’s on your to-do list?

• You will be the main technical point of contact for your department.
• Electrical or mechanical fault? You’ll pinpoint the problem and find a solution!
• You’ll calibrate and optimise machinery to ensure production runs smoothly.
• You’ll work with PLC systems, motors, sensors and variable speed drives.
• You read electrical diagrams and delve into technical drawings.
• You also tackle hydraulic and pneumatic problems.
• You monitor maintenance and scheduled interventions and keep the technical documentation up to date.
You’re our ideal candidate if…

• You have a bachelor’s degree in electromechanics, with a focus on electrical engineering, or equivalent experience.
• You combine technical insight with a genuine ‘can-do’ attitude.
• You can analyse and resolve faults independently.
• You work accurately and always put safety first.
• You work well both independently and as part of a team.
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English.
Ready to put your technical skills into practice? Send us a message and find out if this job could be your next step!

Are you the passionate technician we're looking for to strengthen our team? Agristo, a market leader in the food industry, is looking for a preventive maintenance technician who is passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. As a technician, you play a crucial role in ensuring maximum uptime for our machinery.Are you up to the challenge?Then this job at Agristo, at our Wielsbeke site, is for you!What will you be doing at Agristo?As a maintenance technician, you're passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. Your objective? To ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime. 
• Set an example by following the prescribed guidelines and procedures for a (food) safe, environmentally friendly and orderly working environment. 
• As a technician, you recognise potential problems before they cause breakdowns. You report these observations accurately, enabling us to act proactively and minimise unscheduled downtime. 
• You carry out planned maintenance tasks, such as inspections, lubrications, adjustments and replacements. 
• You will work closely with our operational teams and your technical colleagues to optimise the maintenance plan. 
• You will provide the necessary support and follow-up to external collaborators to ensure that their contribution is effective and efficient. In addition, you will mentor technical trainees and new employees to help them progress in their role. 
• You will keep accurate records of maintenance work carried out, using the maintenance software (Ultimo).
 
• You have technical training or equivalent experience. 
• You have several years' experience as a technician and a passion for technology. 
• You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems. 
• You have a proactive attitude. 
• You have logical thinking and good problem-solving skills, enabling you to work independently. 
• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and collective success. 
• You speak Dutch, French or English and are prepared to understand colleagues who speak other languages. 
• You are prepared to work in a 2-shift system.

Are you a passionate machine learning engineer with expertise in generative AI? Join our Machine Learning Enablers team at Proximus Ada, where you’ll play a key role in advancing and scaling generative AI capabilities across teams. You will leverage your expertise in architectures such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent-based systems to develop and maintain reusable components and templates that enable data scientists to deliver impactful solutions. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with data scientists in delivery teams and engineers from our Cloud and DevSecOps teams to implement best practices and ensure technical excellence across multiple projects. Using frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph and our Azure-first stack, you will maintain and expand a shared repository of reusable generative AI assets that enable scalable, reliable solutions. 

Your innovative mindset will help identify emerging techniques and translate them into practical building blocks that deliver business value, keeping our teams aligned with the latest advances. Your work will support the day-to-day needs of our data scientists through the practical maintenance, hands-on support, and enhancement of shared assets, while also driving innovation in our generative AI initiatives. 

Responsibilities 

Develop and Maintain our Generative AI Repository 

• Manage and expand our shared repository of reusable Generative AI components and templates, ensuring it is robust, up-to-date, well-documented, and easy to adopt across use cases. 
• Support onboarding and adoption: help teams use the repository effectively, keep alignment with the main branch, and facilitate clean integration of shared changes. 
• Collaborate with data scientists to identify new components to build, provide technical support, and promote best practices in using the repository. 
• Drive key upgrades and migrations of core libraries and templates (e.g., LangChain/LangGraph) with minimal disruption to delivery teams. 
Enable Agent-Based and Generative AI Solutions 

• Guide delivery teams on architectures such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent-based systems, providing hands-on technical support and troubleshooting when needed. 
• Research and prototype emerging techniques, frameworks, and Azure services; translate validated approaches into reusable building blocks for delivery teams. 
Collaborate and Drive Technical Excellence 

• Define and promote software engineering best practices for Generative AI solutions (testing, code quality, style, automation) and enforce them through PR reviews and shared standards. 
• Collaborate with Cloud, DevSecOps, enterprise architecture, and vendors to ensure solutions and technologies align with our stack and constraints.
• Stay current with advances in Generative AI and communicate relevant learnings and recommendations to the organization. 
 

Profile

Education 

• Master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. 
• A Ph.D. is a plus, especially with research in Generative AI or agent-based systems. 
Professional Experience 

• Minimum of 2+ years of relevant experience in a business environment in AI/ML engineering or software engineering.
• Proven experience working with generative AI models and LLMs in real-world projects. 
• Demonstrated ability to build reusable components and templates, and transition proof-of-concepts into production-ready assets. 
• Experience collaborating with delivery teams and stakeholders, providing technical guidance and support. 
Technical Skills 

• Strong coding skills in Python, with solid software engineering best practices (testing, code quality, documentation, maintainable design). 
• Proficiency with version control (Git) and modern development workflows, including CI/CD pipelines. 
• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and relevant Azure Data & AI services. 
• Experience with Generative AI frameworks such as LangChain; familiarity with LangGraph is a plus. 
• Experience implementing MLOps best practices (e.g., experiment tracking with MLflow). 
• Familiarity with monitoring and evaluation practices for Generative AI applications. 
Soft Skills 

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail.
• Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts, provide actionable guidance, and produce high-quality documentation. 
• Collaboration and enablement mindset: comfortable supporting and mentoring others through code reviews and hands-on troubleshooting. 
• Ownership and autonomy: able to prioritize effectively and drive work to completion in a transversal context. 
• Curiosity and innovation mindset: proactive in exploring new techniques and translating them into practical improvements. 
Languages 

• Fluent in English and preferably also French and/or Dutch.

FLYINGGROUP, one of Europe’s leading business jet operators, has an open position for a Flight Care Agent at the main office in Antwerp.

The Flight Care Agent is a member of the Operational Control Centre Team. The main OCC activities are the planning and preparation of FLYINGGROUP’s flights. The OCC supports our global operations and our business is rapidly growing. We are expanding our worldwide activity and are looking for a Flight Care Agent.

Your goal

You will be joining our OCC Flight Care Department which always strives to make the most informed decisions and provide top-quality service to our clients, making our company stand out from the rest.

Your duties and responsibilities

You provide good support to the Senior Flight Care Agent in completing other tasks as assigned.

Your profile

• The Flight Care Agent is highly Customer minded and pays full attention to the particulars of each Customer.

• You are well organized, stress-resistant, and able to multitask while maintaining a calm composure and working with continuously changing flight schedules.
• You are highly self-motivated with a proactive approach and like to work in a team.
• You have good geographical knowledge.
• You have good computer knowledge: Word, Excel.
• Experience in aviation is a must, experience in business aviation is a plus
• Have a good base of aviation terminology and IATA and ICAO codes.
• You are flexible, willing to work in shifts and during weekends.
• Local resident is preferable.
Offer

We offer a full-time position with a salary matching your qualifications. The work schedule is flexible in shifts and will include weekend shifts. Training "in-house".

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Permanent Control Officer - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Join BNP Paribas Fortis as an IT Operational Permanent Control (OPC) Specialist At BNP Paribas Fortis, our Cyber Security division unites the Centre of Excellence (CoE) Security and IT Filiere Production Security BE to design, implement, and maintain robust security solutions. Our mission? To foster a trustworthy, secure environment for both our colleagues and clients.

We’re seeking a proactive professional to join our IT Operational Permanent Control (OPC) team, a key function within Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC). Here, you’ll play a pivotal role in helping IT and Business Units navigate operational risks tied to IT and Cyber Security, while reinforcing an adaptive, resilient control framework across the bank.

 

AND IN DETAIL

• Identification and assessment of risks: You’ll analyse data from risk systems, reports, and governance bodies, turning complex information into practical, risk-based insights. Your conclusions will help leaders make informed decisions.
• Controls Execution & Reporting: You’ll interpret, adapt, and run control tests (compliance, fraud, outsourcing, etc.), then report findings to the CIO, ensuring controls align with IT’s strategic priorities.
• Regulatory & Internal Reporting: You’ll prepare precise, high-impact reports for the Internal Control Committee (ExCo), regulators (NBB/BNB, ECB), and Group entities (CDF/IT Group), shaping risk discussions at the highest level.
• Procedure Governance: As the gatekeeper for IT risk and security procedures, you’ll ensure they’re up to date, accessible, and visible, keeping our compliance framework structured and resilient.
• Governance Body Support: Acting as NAC secretary for major IT initiatives, you’ll track stakeholder conditions (Business & Functions), driving accountability and alignment in high-impact projects.
• Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA): You’ll conduct the annual RCSA for all IT risk categories, using the RISK ORM methodology to assess risks, incidents, and recommendations, giving a full picture of IT’s risk profile, including external threats.
• Regulatory Reporting – IT Risk Questionnaire: You’ll coordinate the bank’s response to the ECB’s IT Risk questionnaire (via Group) and the NBB’s BNP Paribas Fortis reporting, ensuring submissions are accurate, regulator-ready, and endorsed by the CISO/CIO.
• Compliance Controls Execution: You’ll run IT-wide compliance checks (awareness, ethics, etc.), report findings to the IT Management Team, and drive remediation where needed, ensuring actions are documented and evidenced.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Background & Experience

• A Master’s degree in IT, economics, or engineering, with a strong IT foundation.
• 10+ years of experience, including at least 5 years in Risk or IT whether in financial services, consulting, or another regulated industry.  
What You Bring to the Table

• IT & Security Process Insight: You understand how IT and security technologies integrate into risk and operational frameworks and where the gaps might be.
• Risk Assessment Skills: Hands-on experience in identifying and evaluating IT and cyber risks, with a practical (not just theoretical) approach.
• Regulatory & Standards Know-How: Familiarity with frameworks like EBA guidelines, DORA, ISO 27001, or NIST and the ability to apply them in real-world IT risk and compliance scenarios.
• Control Design & Testing: You can translate regulations and policies into effective controls and know how to test whether they actually work.
• Agile Mindset: Experience with Agile methodologies in a risk or control environment is a plus, but adaptability matters most.
• Process Thinking: You quickly grasp end-to-end processes, spot risks, and propose practical solutions without getting lost in bureaucracy.
• Clear Communication: Whether it’s a report for executives or a presentation for regulators, you distill complex topics into concise, actionable messages.
• Stakeholder Alignment: You bridge the gap between technical teams, business units, and regulators keeping everyone aligned without losing sight of compliance and risk goals.
• Collaboration: You thrive in cross-functional teams, working smoothly with colleagues and partners to execute risk and control initiatives.  
Practicalities

• Languages: Fluent in French or Dutch, with strong English (written and spoken).
• Tools: Comfortable with SharePoint, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
• Nice-to-have: Experience with RISK 360 is a plus, but not a must.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

You’ll be the guardian of data quality making sure the information we rely on is accurate, reliable, and ready to power everything from seamless customer experiences to cutting-edge digital solutions. Think of it as being the detective, the problem-solver, and the strategist all in one, working with teams across the bank to keep our data in top shape.

 

AND IN DETAIL

As a Client Data Quality Analyst, here’s what your day could look like:

• Spot the gaps, fix the flaws. You’ll design and monitor data quality controls, using dashboards to track how well our systems are performing. 
• Turn data into a strategic advantage. You won’t just be fixing problems, you’ll be helping us use data smarter. That could mean:
• Upgrading dashboards so they give clearer, more actionable insights.
• Documenting metadata so everyone understands what our data means and how to use it.
• Supporting data certification and joining key committees to ensure we’re meeting the highest standards.
• Sharing your know-how with the wider Data Quality team, so we all keep getting better.
• Be the bridge between data and real-world impact You’ll get to know our client data flows and applications inside out, becoming the go-to person. Your work will directly help us improve customer experiences, streamline processes, and stay ahead in a fast-changing industry.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

We’re looking for someone who:

•  Loves solving puzzles. You see data as more than numbers; it’s a story waiting to be uncovered. Experience in data quality analysis (especially in banking) is a big plus.
• Speaks “data” fluently. You understand data lifecycles, governance, and how data drives decisions. You’ve done analysis that shows real business impact and you’re passionate about digital transformation.
• Is tech-savvy (but not a coding genius). You’re comfortable with tools like Excel, MS Access, PowerPoint, and Business Objects. If you’ve worked with Collibra, Ab Initio, Tableau, SQL, or Python, even better, but what matters most is your curiosity and willingness to learn.
• Communicates clearly and collaborates easily. You can explain complex ideas in simple terms (in French, Dutch, or English). You’re a team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and learning from others.
• Thrives on challenges. You don’t shy away from tricky problems. Instead, you roll up your sleeves, ask the right questions, and push for solutions that actually work.

jobs.occupation: Web Content Management Engineer - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Agile Production Services (APS) tribe is where IT Production happens. As part of a tight-knit group of 7 teams, we handle end-to-end Production Services, from go-live support to 24/7 on-call troubleshooting (yes, nights and weekends included).

Your role? The tech backbone of our digital operations. Whether it’s Level 2/3 support, application security, or hosting optimization, you’ll work closely with Infrastructure and Dev teams to keep our systems fast, secure, and reliable. No two days are the same - and that’s the way we like it.

AND IN DETAIL

As our WCM Specialist, you’ll be the go-to person for all things Web Content Management. 

That means:

• Ownership of WCM expertise: you’ll be the resident guru on TeamSite, headless architecture, and best practices. When teams need answers, they come to you.
• Building, integrating, improving: you’ll analyze, develop, or implement new components, working with Application Leads and integrators to push boundaries. 
• Keeping the Portal running smoothly: but not just maintaining it. You’ll help shape the future vision in our WCM guild (our tech community).
• Documentation that actually helps: you’ll turn complex setups into clear, actionable guides for stakeholders. No jargon-heavy manuals.
• Collaborating with architects: you’ll assist in cost-benefit analyses for new web implementations. 
• Security and performance first: you’ll play an active role in incident, problem, and change management. Finding issues, fixing them, preventing repeats.
• Setting standards: you’ll ensure every user, on every device, has a seamless experience.
• Monitoring and optimizing: you’ll track performance, spot bottlenecks, and keep things running at peak efficiency.
• On-call duty: One week per month (18:00–7:30), you’re the go-to person. But don’t worry: you’re never alone.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

What you bring:

• 5+ years of experience.
• OpenText mastery: you know TeamSite, LiveSite, OpenDeploy inside out, in an Agile/XP environment.
• Your tech toolkit:
• JavaScript, Node.js, NPM, React, Webpack, Jest, SASS, HTML5 are your daily drivers.
• CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Nexus). You automate like it’s second nature.
• Headless WCM architecture (especially TeamSite). You don’t just understand it, you make it work.
• Sharp analytical skills. You spot problems before they happen.
 

How you work:

• Team player, but self-driven: you take initiative and own your work.
• Fast learner: new tools? You pick them up quickly and put them to use.
• Open-minded and adaptable: change is the only constant in tech, and you thrive in it.
• Detail-oriented, but big-picture aware: you follow processes without losing sight of the end goal.
• Clear communicator: whether it’s tech talk with devs or updates for management, you get your point across.
• Persistent and committed: you don’t quit until the job’s done right.
• Comfortable in a multicultural environment: different backgrounds, one shared mission.
 

Languages:

• Fluent English (written and spoken) is a must.
• Dutch and/or French? A definite plus.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

As Test Automation Engineer, you’ll join an enthusiastic multidisciplinary team at our HQ in Brussels to develop qualitative applications in a fast-changing IT landscape. Your role will contribute to innovations benefiting millions of clients, ensuring product and code quality from start to finish through test automation.

AND IN DETAIL

As a test automation engineer, you’ll be joining an enthusiastic multidisciplinary team. Together, you develop qualitative applications for a fast-changing IT landscape: an exciting and versatile challenge! 

• You monitor product and code quality, from start to finish
• You help determine the feature test plan and the test scope
• You focus maximum on automation of test cases
• You share your test results
• You identify and correct any sticking points and iron out any bugs
You know your way around :

• Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Java and test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber etc.).
• Create comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test data for both functional and non-functional testing.
• Execute automated tests, analyze results, and report defects with detailed logs and steps for replication.
• Integrate test automation into CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment) pipelines.
• Work with the development team to identify areas for automation and prioritize test cases.
• Debug and troubleshoot automation scripts and applications in various environments.
• Ensure the scalability, reliability, and effectiveness of automated test frameworks and tools.
• Maintain documentation for test automation frameworks, processes, and results.
• Have knowledge on the standards in software testing (ISTQB)

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• You’re the physical embodiment of the scrum values: involvement, focus, openness and respect, with a good dose of courage to boot
• You’re inquisitive and driven—and you’re always on the ball
• You thrive in a team environment, happily sharing your knowledge and insights
• You are quick to make connections and dare to question everything that deserves to be questioned
• You obtained your bachelor or master degree in Computer Sciences or IT 
• You have a good knowledge of Dutch or French, and great English skills
You surprise us with your experience or knowledge of the tools and/or programming languages below: 

• Java
• Selenium
• Cypress
• Gherkin
• Jmeter
• Postman
• Ruby
• PHP 
• Jenkins
• Swagger
• Gitlab
• Python

For an international company active in the automotive sector, we are looking for a passionate and proactive Communication Officer. The company specializes in innovative vehicle solutions and operates across several international markets.

You will join an international environment where communication plays an important role in showcasing the company's expertise, projects and solutions. You will work closely with different teams and have the opportunity to bring your own ideas to life.

Description
Your responsibilities

Your profile

• You are genuinely passionate about communication and content creation. You take initiative, think ahead and don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be done. You identify opportunities, come up with ideas and turn them into concrete actions.

As a production worker, you're the driving force behind the production process. You ensure the production line always runs smoothly by replenishing and trimming meat as needed. Don't worry if you don't have experience with knives – you'll learn! You'll also help load and unload trucks and work in various departments, such as production, packaging, and shipping. No two days are the same for a production worker, and that's what makes it so rewarding.
We're looking for a production worker who's a hands-on person.

You're physically fit, speak fluent Dutch or English, and enjoy working independently and as part of a team. As a production worker, you take responsibility, remain calm under pressure, and prioritize effectively.
